rules.title: 2026 Relocation Assistance Payments for Owner Move-In and Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting tenants for an owner move-in or under the Ellis Act must pay a standard relocation assistance payment of $19,413, plus an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.

coverage.summary: Tenants subject to owner move-in evictions under the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance or Ellis Act evictions under the Ellis Implementation Ordinance.
coverage.unresolvable: Applicability determined by Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance and Ellis Implementation Ordinance coverage rules.

rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; Ellis Implementation Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The standard relocation assistance payment will increase to $19,413. The additional relocation assistance payment for qualifying households will increase to $6,471.
